lead-intake-qualifier: Checks each new enquiry and prepares a brief so your sales team can decide who should follow up.
sales-followup-coordinator: Prepares a follow-up for your review, or flags when the team should leave a lead alone.
account-researcher: Gathers the facts about a prospect into a short brief with sources for your sales team.
inbound-lead-to-meeting-review: Checks new enquiries, prepares a meeting invitation for review and tracks confirmed bookings.
pipeline-health-to-owned-action: Checks why a deal has stalled and prepares a next step for the salesperson responsible.
store-operations-coordinator: Investigates stuck orders, stock problems and delivery delays so your store team knows what needs attention.
returns-refunds-coordinator: Checks a return or refund request against the order and your policy, then prepares a decision and customer reply.
checkout-recovery-coordinator: Checks whether a checkout still needs follow-up and whether contact is allowed, then drafts a recovery message for review.
order-exception-to-resolution: Brings the order problem and refund request together so your team can approve a resolution and check what happened.
inventory-risk-to-reviewed-replenishment: Flags stock at risk of running out and prepares a reorder proposal using the supplier information available.
funnel-analyst: Compares signup, product use and billing records to show where potential customers drop out before paying.
product-adoption-analyst: Checks whether customers are using a feature and reaching the useful first result your team defined.
lifecycle-analyst: Compares groups of customers over time so your team can see who gets started and who keeps coming back.
funnel-conversion-intelligence: Investigates a change in your signup-to-payment funnel and proposes an experiment for your team to review.
activation-retention-intelligence: Compares how customer groups get started and return, then proposes a retention experiment for your review.
release-quality-assistant: Collects the checks for a specific release and highlights missing evidence so the release owner can decide whether to ship.
browser-journey-qa-analyst: Tries the customer journeys you choose and brings back screenshots and steps to reproduce any failures.
incident-investigator: Builds a timeline from alerts, logs and recent releases so your engineers can investigate an incident with the evidence together.
security-remediation-coordinator: Tracks a security finding from its assigned owner through the fix, deployment and independent recheck.
cloud-cost-analyst: Explains changes in your cloud bill and prepares savings options with the risks for your team to review.
support-triage-assistant: Sorts incoming support cases by urgency, removes duplicates and prepares the next action for the right teammate.
support-reply-drafter: Drafts a customer reply from your approved help content and case details, flagging questions that still need an answer.
escalation-coordinator: Keeps a difficult customer case moving between teams, with a clear owner, current evidence and the decisions still needed.
feedback-review-analyst: Groups customer feedback into recurring themes so your team can decide what to fix and review proposed replies.
support-case-to-reviewed-resolution: Checks a customer case, prepares a reply or handoff for review and follows up on the recorded outcome.
invoice-chasing: Finds overdue invoices that need attention and prepares reminders for review without chasing the same customer twice.
failed-payment-recovery: Investigates a failed payment, checks retries and previous contact, then proposes the next step for your billing team.
refund-review: Checks the original payment and previous refunds so an approver can review the right refund amount.
billing-operations-coordinator: Brings overdue invoices, failed payments, refunds and disputes together with proposed next steps and replies for approval.
subscription-receivable-to-verified-outc: Investigates an unpaid subscription invoice, prepares the follow-up for review and checks whether payment was collected.
website-growth-starter: Reviews your website and turns the opportunities it finds into a measurable plan for attracting relevant visitors.
seo-analyst: Finds technical problems that make your pages harder to discover in search and prioritizes what to fix.
ai-visibility-analyst: Tests your buyers’ questions in AI search tools and shows where your business appears, is missing or lacks a supporting source.
competitor-intelligence-analyst: Tracks changes in the competitors you choose and explains which ones matter for your offer and buyers.
seo-intelligence: Combines a technical website review with buyer questions to propose search improvements for your team to approve.
